cues.zh: 我们可以在外部安装仪器。我们可以观察性能。但真正来说，如果我们想了解

cues.zh: 发动机内部的燃烧过程，我们没有简单的方法做到。

cues.en: There is a tremendous benefit to being able to model the mixing
cues.zh: 能够对混合过程进行建模有巨大的好处

cues.en: in simulation
cues.zh: 在模拟中

cues.en: directly.
cues.zh: 直接进行。

cues.en: We can then optimize over a wide variety of injector configurations and test just a few.
cues.zh: 然后，我们可以针对多种喷射器配置进行优化，只需测试少数几种。

cues.en: Another very important insight that could be gained into rocket engines
cues.zh: 另一个关于火箭发动机非常重要的洞见

cues.en: would be that of combustion instability,
cues.zh: 是燃烧不稳定性，

cues.en: which is the coupling of pressure waves and chemical energy release.
cues.zh: 即压力波与化学能量释放的耦合。

cues.en: That is a phenomenon that has delayed for
cues.zh: 这一现象已经延误了

cues.en: many years many different engine development programs. It is the bane of engine development.
cues.zh: 许多不同的发动机研发项目多年。它是发动机研发的祸根。

cues.en: You start it going, it starts to shake, and it either comes apart or it just continues to shake so violently you can't put any payload on top of the vehicle because it'll just shake it too much. So having insight into that from a simulation standpoint
cues.zh: 一旦启动，它就开始振动，要么解体，要么持续剧烈振动，以至于无法在飞行器顶部放置任何有效载荷，因为振动会过于剧烈。因此，从仿真的角度深入了解这一问题

cues.en: would be tremendously valuable.
cues.zh: 将极具价值。

cues.en: What are the challenges?
cues.zh: 挑战是什么？

cues.en: One major challenge that makes combustion CFD in a rocket engine different from other types of CFD,
cues.zh: 使火箭发动机中的燃烧CFD不同于其他类型CFD的一个主要挑战，

cues.en: including aerodynamics
cues.zh: 包括空气动力学

cues.en: and general fluid flow,
cues.zh: 和一般流体流动，

cues.en: is the wide variety of time scale here. So you can see we have, on the molecular scale, diffusion and reaction processes.
cues.zh: 是这里时间尺度的多样性。所以你可以看到，在分子尺度上，我们有扩散和反应过程。

cues.en: We have flow fields at an intermediate time scale.
cues.zh: 我们有中等时间尺度的流场。

cues.en: And we have things such as acoustics,
cues.zh: 还有诸如声学之类的东西，

cues.en: which, again, feed into combustion instabilities. We definitely would want to capture those.
cues.zh: 这些又会反馈到燃烧不稳定性中。我们肯定希望捕捉到这些。

cues.en: In addition,
cues.zh: 此外，

cues.en: the combustion residence time is a very important factor.
cues.zh: 燃烧停留时间是一个非常关键的因素。

cues.en: So one could say, and this is true, that the automotive industry has adopted combustion CFD,
cues.zh: 因此可以说，而且确实如此，汽车行业已经采用了燃烧CFD，

cues.en: and it has yielded quite a bit of progress for that industry.
cues.zh: 并且为该行业带来了相当大的进步。

cues.en: In addition, the gas turbine industry also uses combustion CFD.
cues.zh: 此外，燃气轮机行业也会使用燃烧 CFD。

cues.en: In an automotive combustion chamber, you're doing a compression stroke, and at the bottom of that stroke, you've mixed your gases.
cues.zh: 在汽车发动机的燃烧室里，你正在进行压缩冲程，而在该冲程底部，各种气体已经混合好了。

cues.en: And you ignite them, and the combustion process happens over a relatively short time scale.
cues.zh: 然后你点燃它们，燃烧过程会在相对较短的时间尺度内发生。

cues.en: But by the time that piston reaches the top of its stroke, you're generally done with that combustion process, and you can then exhaust the products. In a rocket chamber,
cues.zh: 但等到活塞到达上止点时，燃烧过程通常已经结束，之后就可以排出产物。而在火箭燃烧室中，

cues.en: your propellants last for fractions of a second inside of this device before they're ejected out through the throat and expand out of the nozzle. That is a very important time scale to keep in mind.
cues.zh: 推进剂在这个装置内只停留几分之一秒，然后就被从喉部喷出，并在喷管中膨胀。这是一个必须牢记的非常重要的时间尺度。

cues.en: The chemical reactions, of course, happen on the nanosecond timescale. And we definitely want to get those right because if you assume the reactions have reacted
cues.zh: 当然，化学反应发生在纳秒时间尺度上。我们肯定希望把它们算对，因为如果你假设这些反应已经

cues.en: to completion,
cues.zh: 进行完全，

cues.en: you're missing something because in reality, the chemicals are reacting as they're injected and then they're gone. And a lot of times, that reaction process hasn't fully taken place.
cues.zh: 你就有遗漏，因为现实中，化学物质在喷入时就在反应，然后很快就没了。而且很多时候，反应过程并没有完全发生。

cues.en: Another major challenge of combustion CFD
cues.zh: 燃烧 CFD 的另一个重大挑战

cues.en: is the wide variety of length scales in the problem.
cues.zh: 是问题中的长度尺度范围非常广。

cues.en: So what I'm showing here is the energy cascade diagram,
cues.zh: 所以这里我展示的是能量级联图，

cues.en: and the easiest way to understand this is to consider a cup of coffee. When you stir your cup of coffee, after some amount of time, it actually stops rotating and comes to rest.
cues.zh: 理解它的最简单方式是想想一杯咖啡。你搅拌咖啡后，过一段时间，它实际上会停止旋转，静止下来。

cues.en: And what that is is you're putting energy into the coffee. You're mechanically stirring it in a big circle, and you have this large structure.
cues.zh: 这就是你把能量注入咖啡里。你在用机械方式把它搅成一个大圆圈，于是形成了这个大型结构。

cues.en: But due to the viscosity
cues.zh: 但由于流体的

cues.en: of the fluid, you get these little secondary eddies as the cream mixes,
cues.zh: 黏性，奶油混合时会产生这些小尺度次级涡旋，

cues.en: and you see those eddies get smaller and smaller until you get down to the level where viscous effects dominate. So basically, the friction of the fluid against itself
cues.zh: 你会看到这些涡旋越来越小，直到降到黏性效应主导的尺度。所以基本上，流体自身的摩擦

cues.en: dissipates that energy, and your cup of coffee is a tiny bit warmer because that's where your energy went. So the cascade of energy from where you put it in at large scales, in the case of a rocket engine, the injector,
cues.zh: 耗散了那股能量，你那杯咖啡会稍微暖一点，因为你的能量就去了那里。所以能量从你输入的大尺度开始级联——在火箭发动机的情况下就是喷注器，

cues.en: down to where it's dissipated,
cues.zh: 一直降到它被耗散的尺度，

cues.en: in this case, Kamagorov scale or the scale at which these structures
cues.zh: 在这个例子里就是柯尔莫哥洛夫尺度，也就是这些结构

cues.en: dissipate into thermal energy,
cues.zh: 耗散为热能的尺度，

cues.en: which incidentally is the scale at which combustion mixing happens,
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，这也正是燃烧混合发生的尺度，

cues.en: is about six orders of magnitude, a factor of a million.
cues.zh: 大约跨越六个数量级，也就是一百万倍。

cues.en: So if you think of subdividing any sort of CFD mesh
cues.zh: 所以如果你想把任何 CFD 网格

cues.en: by powers of two over and over again, you need to subdivide it about 20 times in order to span that dynamic range of length scales.
cues.zh: 反复按二的幂次细分，你需要细分大约 20 次才能覆盖那个长度尺度的动态范围。

cues.en: If you were to uniformly populate a grid
cues.zh: 如果你要在一个大约一米见方的燃烧室和喷注器

cues.en: on the order of a combustion chamber and injector it's about a meter cubed we're talking about Yautabytes of data.
cues.zh: 范围内均匀铺满网格，我们说的是约尧字节的数据量。

cues.en: Just not feasible,
cues.zh: 这完全不可行，

cues.en: not really a reasonable thing to look at.
cues.zh: 根本不是一个合理的做法。

cues.en: So there must be something we can do, and in fact, typically people will do closure models for the turbulence. They'll resolve down to some scale and say, Okay, we don't know what's happening below that, And that's just because you can only have one or the other. You can either have a big simulation domain and you can look at a lot of different things, or you can really zoom in and get the detail right.
cues.zh: 所以我们必须有别的办法，事实上，人们通常会对湍流做闭合模型。他们会解析到某个尺度，然后说，好吧，我们不知道那以下发生了什么，而这只是因为两者只能取其一。你要么拥有大的模拟域、能观察很多不同的东西，要么就得真正放大、把细节做对。

cues.en: Why not have it both

cues.en: ways?
cues.zh: 有哪些方式？
